description: Canonical registry of authority-set policy symbols and deterministic projections from accepted CBA control state. Registry rows are templates, not authority: each lease carries the concrete AuthoritySetPolicy and its digest, and verifiers rederive it from basis_ref plus CBA closure.
registry_rules: authority_set_id values MUST be unique and MUST match the concrete AuthoritySetPolicy.authority_set_id
A concrete policy MUST use the registered policy_kind and source_kind, then project authorization_rules exactly from fixed_rules or rules_source
authorization_rules MUST be ordered lexicographically by rule_id; each rule's issuers MUST be ordered lexicographically by verification_method and allowed_actions MUST be ordered lexicographically

A lease is authorized only by the unique registered rule whose rule_id equals authorization_rule_id and whose allowed_actions covers action; different rules MAY cover the same action, rules are alternatives, and proofs MUST NOT be combined across rules
authority_set_digest is SHA-256(JCS(the complete concrete AuthoritySetPolicy object))
A verifier MUST rederive source_ref, source_digest, generation_ref and issuer verification methods from the accepted basis; inline policy bytes are portable evidence, not an authority source
A candidate or post-basis control object MUST NOT create authority for a lease evaluated at an earlier basis

policies.rules_source: accepted_recovery_policy.publication_authorization_rules rederived from allowed_proof_kinds and linked accepted state

projection.authorization_rules: one rule per allowed proof kind; principal_signing/recovery_unlock/trusted service use threshold 1, device_quorum uses device_quorum.k, threshold_recovery uses its recovered signing key with threshold 1 (Shamir reconstruction k is not a signature quorum)
